title_en: Everything Announced at the Marvel Studios SDCC Panel | Comic Con 2026
summary_en: We’re finally here! San Diego Comic-Con 2026 will soon have its big Marvel moment, and IGN will be in the front row reporting live from Marvel Studios' Hall H panel. The action kicks off at 5.30pm PT / 8.30pm ET / 1.30am, July 26 UK time. So be sure to check back here for all the announcements, trailer information, and anything else the Marvel Cinematic Universe has up its sleeve for fans.
body_en:
We’re finally here! San Diego Comic-Con 2026 will soon have its big Marvel moment, and IGN will be in the front row reporting live from Marvel Studios' Hall H panel. The action kicks off at 5.30pm PT / 8.30pm ET / 1.30am, July 26 UK time. So be sure to check back here for all the announcements, trailer information, and anything else the Marvel Cinematic Universe has up its sleeve for fans.
So, what should we expect? Well, Avengers: Doomsday is out this December, and we just got its first proper trailer. So I’m sure we’ll get plenty of Doomsday talk from Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige and perhaps some (or maybe even many!) of its stars. Maybe we’ll get some casting announcements — could there be room in Doomsday for even more characters? We will hopefully see new footage. Maybe we’ll even get a tease for next year’s Secret Wars.
The big hope is that Marvel Studios does its big timeline of releases thing, and outlines the future of the MCU beyond Secret Wars. We know that Feige plans for a reset moment — although he insists it’s not a reboot . Could we get an announcement for the first post-Secret Wars movie?
This week, Feige said Marvel had mapped out its movie plans up to 2042 , and he hinted at a "streamlined, simplified" universe post-Avengers: Secret Wars, a big push for the new X-Men, and plans to eventually unveil a live-action Miles Morales. Surely it's time to get a better idea of how it will all work, and if so, maybe tonight's the night.
We’ll find out more in just a few hours.
Wesley is Director, News at IGN. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.
